title: Correct formula application
description: Essential Criteria: Student must apply the formula F = BIL for part (1) with correct values.

title: Part (1) numerical answer
description: Essential Criteria: Student must obtain 0.25 N (or equivalent) as the force magnitude for part (1).

title: Angle consideration
description: Important Criteria: Student must recognize that force depends on angle between current and magnetic field, using sinθ.

title: Part (2) zero force
description: Essential Criteria: Student must state that force becomes zero when wire is parallel to field (θ=0°).

title: Units included
description: Optional Criteria: Student includes correct units (N) with numerical answers.

title: Missing angle factor
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly uses F = BIL without sinθ for non-perpendicular cases.

title: Sign or direction confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student confuses magnitude with direction or introduces incorrect signs.
